content: Hyprland ecosystem gap (Hyprland wiki Useful-Utilities + ecosystem knowledge): Hyprland ships no settings app; users assemble nwg-look (GTK look), nwg-displays (monitors), hyprpaper (wallpaper), hyprpanel/waybar (indicators), pamixer (audio), bluetoothctl, nm-applet, hyprshade (gamma), and hand-edit hyprland.conf for keybinds/blur/opacity. Community pain: fragmented tools, conf editing with no validation/preview, missing tray utilities (auth agent, portals, notification daemon) break apps. Official HyprGui (Qt6) is in development - validate scope against it before GUI phase.
